rubrics.description: How fully does the reply resolve the customer's request? Score 0 if it gives no relevant solution or next step. Score 1 if it gives a useful step but leaves part of the request unanswered. Score 2 if it gives a complete solution or all the next steps the customer needs to proceed.

How respectfully does the reply address the customer? Score 1 if it blames, mocks, or dismisses the customer. Score 2 if it stays civil but gives an impersonal response. Score 3 if it stays civil and acknowledges the customer's specific concern respectfully.
